messages:
mike: FYI we're getting support tickets saying the console shows both v1 and v2 token consumption for the same request. noticed spikes during long convo sessions where v2 times out and we immediately route to v1. :confused:

anya: thanks for flagging. do we bill per attempt right now? I thought billing dedupes retries.

mike: currently we emit a token metric on each attempt and billing ingests attempts. UI queries per-version totals so it looks doubled. sample trace: `req=6930001111 -> v2 (timeout 1800ms) -> v1 (200ms) success`

deepa: two things to solve: avoid customer-facing confusion in the console, and stop double billing on automatic fallbacks. proposal: attribution ledger that records attempts and then writes a single settled record for billing. add `x-rw-attrib-id` to requests to tie attempts together.

zach: agree. also want a short "version confidence" signal emitted so console can show "low confidence" badge when routing is uncertain. low-cardinality buckets: high/med/low.

billing-bot: implementation note: billing needs the settled record format: {attrib_id, final_version, tokens, settled_ts}. We will shadow-read settled records for 2 weeks before switching. Retro invoices remain unchanged; any >1% discrepancy flagged for credits review.

mike: console UX: show a pending bucket in the per-model breakdown and tooltip: "Tokens pending attribution - reconciles shortly". default reconciliation window target 5m, max SLA 10m.

anya: add tenant-level toggle: "strict_version" that disables automatic fallbacks (pin to one version). warn users about increased errors. default OFF. also add a small banner when enabled.

deepa: telemetry: emit `rw.routing.decision` metric with labels tenant, route, confidence_bucket. Also attach `rw_attrib_id` as a trace tag. sample at 0.5% to avoid high cardinality.

zach: infra: ledger must be idempotent and have TTL (48h). flush job writes settled records to billing topic. ensure encryption and proof-of-request hash for disputes.

mike: rollout plan: 1) header propagation + ledger in canary 2) console pending bucket for canary tenants 3) billing shadow consumption 4) flip after 2w. add escape hatch flag.

anya: who owns what? mike -> RFC + rollout coordination. deepa -> ledger + schema + flush. zach -> infra + alerts. billing-bot -> billing shadow and credits policy. I'll own console copy and dashboard patch.

billing-bot: deploy queued: attribution-ledger v1.0 -> canary us-west-2 subset=1pct.

mike: opening RFC now, tagging @deepa @zach @anya.
